label: TP
reason: User input from cookies flows directly into the XPath expression without sanitization. Although XXE is disabled via disallow-doctype-decl, this does not prevent XPath Injection vulnerabilities where payloads manipulate the XPath syntax (e.g., via attribute selectors). The data flow from the decoded cookie value to the XPath compile() call constitutes a genuine vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input from cookie flows to param, then to bar, then directly into XPath expression without sanitization
